The institutional investor held 123,332 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.44M, up from 120,373 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ashfield Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Chevron Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $233.50B market cap company. It closed at $122.19 lastly.
